say: Hey there! We have some top transfer tips for the upcoming gameweek.
Today, we're focusing on defenders and forwards.
Let's start with the defense. Switching over to the defensive section now.
Arsenal's Gabriel is the clear number one among defenders,
thanks to his high form and the Gunners' solid backline.
His teammate Jurrien Timber is a great alternative,
offering serious attacking threat at an excellent price point.
Now let's switch gears and look at the strikers.
Heading over to the forwards section.
Brighton's João Pedro is currently the most sought-after forward.
His value for money is simply unbeatable right now.
Our dark horse pick is Ekitiké. His expected goals data is very promising,
suggesting more points are coming soon.
We hope these picks help you dominate your mini-leagues.
Good luck and see you in the next one!
Happy point hunting and good luck!
